works.body:
𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐈🌈-san, nice to meet you. I really love the style of your illustrations, so I'm sending you a request for characters we used in my friends' and my TRPG. (I have permission from my friends.) ◆About the Characters 【First】Bella Ainerus｜182cm・Female Image Cocktail: Piña Colada
Recommended Flavor: Coconut Milk & Pineapple Former corpse carrier. Founder of the ice cream shop. Bella was the one who scouted the two. She's easygoing and optimistic. She likes the two and is always teasing them, whispering "I love you" as a joke and touching them a lot. She's the most muscular of the three. 【Second】 Chiara Martin｜179cm・Female
Image cocktail: China Blue Recommended flavor: Tomato & Tabasco Former soldier. Selfish person. Blunt and somewhat harsh with customers. However, she cares about her friends and works with them despite everything. The most slender of the three. [Third] Asha Fisk | 150cm, Female Image cocktail: Cassis Soda Recommended flavor: Cassis Berry Soda
Former babysitter. Baby-faced but mature physique, the ice cream shop's poster girl. Slightly bratty but has a high boiling point. Mood maker. The most curvaceous of the three. Outwardly, a mobile ice cream vendor. In reality, a killer who accepts requests for murder and kidnapping. Generally close, but they also bicker. Loves drinking together after work.

◆Regarding Commission Details No specific aspect ratio or size requirements. Feel free to alter clothing or other elements! While she often wears black and has many decorations, feel free to omit these or add details based on your imagination for parts without reference material. ◆Usage Permissions Wallpapers, icons, headers for PCs/smartphones Personal merchandise creation If there are issues with payment or missing materials, please resend the request. Thank you for your consideration!

Dear TERI, it is nice to meet you! I don't know if I should say...
First of all, Happy New Year!
I have been seeing your wonderful drawings on X's TL for a long time, and your illustrations of a certain hotel are wonderful. I really like TERI's cartoonish and stylish style, and I always enjoy them on TL!

So I thought ...... might be into it, and I was wondering if you would be interested in drawing a character from my original work, "DEATH MARCH".
I would love to see the characters of my "DEATH MARCH" in your drawing...!
I think it would be difficult to get all 5 characters for this price, so I would be very happy if you could listen to the site and the voice drama if you like, and if you find a character that you like, I would be very happy if you could draw that child!
You can see the standing drawings and profiles from the "PEOPLE" section of the following website!
https://freakstreet666f13.wixsite.com/fromfreakstreet
We will also post the voice drama at the resource URL, so we would be happy if you could use it as a resource.

I know it is early in the New Year, but I would appreciate your consideration!
And we look forward to working with you again this year!

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLeGdDFmyZIDVkqZ_g_tkU1HbLugVyhLrX&si=aGzhI7rw70mj9mzJ

Hello, nice to meet you! I really enjoy your artwork and would like to request art of one of my characters.
She's a vampire with an affinity for beautiful flowers (especially lotus flowers) and butterflies. She is generally a patient, considerate and confident woman, although she can also be quite distrustful and blunt.  She lives in a small city by the sea and works at a local coffee shop. 
Her hair is a dull shade of orange and her eyes are green. She is quite skinny, and she's around 182 cm long.

You are free to draw her however you like! I will leave pose, expression and composition to you and your interpretation of my character.

Thank you so much in advance for your consideration!

Sophia Ryker、眼帯と自分で作った機械の腕を持つメカニックです。ソフィアはとても好奇心旺盛な女の子で、「好奇心は猫を殺したが、彼女が作ったこのロボットアームが彼女を生き返らせた！」というフレーズで学んでいることで知られています。また、助けが必要な人を助けるためにすぐに飛びつくタイプでもあります。ソフィアは、戦いに巻き込まれた場合も、主に腕と体力に頼って反撃します。彼女はいじくり回したり、コーヒーを飲んだり、バイクに乗るのが大好きです。

Jolon Rykerは彼女の兄です！彼はドラゴンの影響を受けた完全なサイボーグです。爆発が大好きで、体が爆発に耐えられるように作られているため、いざというときにはダイナマイトを近くに投げつけることがよくあります。表面上はジョロンは意地悪なことで知られていますが、実際は外見を強靭にしようとしているだけのとても優しい人です。

好きなように描いてください。

私のリクエストを検討してください、ありがとうございます！良い一日を！

Hello, nice to meet you. I will be happy if you can accept this request.

Characters:
Chara A. 178cm. Fluffy red hair. A handsome young man who is pretending to be a virtuous traveling monk. In reality, he summons demons to fight! A confident guy.

Chara B. 169cm. Brown hair. Grey eyes. Wears sunglasses when doing jobs. A dancer who became an assassin due to an incident in her past. Cool lady.

🤝 Relationship
Chara A is Chara B’s boss, to put it loosely. Chara B gets irritated with Chara A and would sometimes start arguments. Chara A does not seem to mind the bad attitude towards him.

📋 Scenario
I want a scenario where it looks like the two are fighting. Chara B is on top of Chara A.

I will leave the composition to you. If there is anything wrong with the request, please decline. Thank you!

DIAはメロディより少し背が高い。怠け者だけど、いざというときは頼りになるかっこいいお姉さんという雰囲気。彼女は思慮深く、行動を起こす前に綿密な計画を立てることを好む。DIAはハンドガンと、爪や大砲などの武器に変形できる腕を使って戦います。趣味は探偵小説。彼女は甘いペストリーとブラックコーヒーが好きだ。ふっくらとした大きな胸と柔らかそうな体。

Melodyはちょっとおてんば娘。とても自信家で、どんな状況にもすぐに適応できる。とても頼りになるが、気が短い。Melodyが使うのは、大きなレンチと剣、そして体力だ。彼女は他の道具や即席の武器も適当に使う。趣味は特撮番組と漫画。辛い食べ物と甘いコーヒーが好きだ。控えめなバスト、むっちりとした太もも、ぷりっとしたキュートなお尻を持つMelody。引き締まったボディの持ち主だ。

ご自由に描いてください。先生にとってかっこいいシーンであればうれしいです。

ご検討よろしくお願いします。
